name: Footnote
oneLiner: Source-grounded community notes for Bluesky, with separate evidence and tone judgments, immutable history, writer bonds, and appeals on GenLayer.
description: Footnote adds source-grounded notes to public Bluesky posts. Four GenLayer contracts separate evidence from tone, preserve versions, hold writer bonds and judge appeals. Validators agree on labels and cited URLs while independently grounding the leader quotes. Finalized StudioNet proof shows an UNSUPPORTED note become SUPPORTED after adding a real NASA source, with both versions retained, plus a note by wallet A appealed by wallet B and settled with receipt-verified native credits. Host, quota and open-appeal recheck guards are proven live. Reading needs no wallet. StudioNet is a simulator: the public demo deployment uses a 15-minute appeal window; production default is 72 hours. Demo grace is 10 minutes and bond release delay is 15 minutes; production grace is 24 hours. Allegations use stricter labels and withhold names, handles and post text from state.
expectedOutcome: Demonstrate an auditable UNSUPPORTED-to-SUPPORTED recheck with immutable history, and an appeal signed by a second wallet with exact settlement balances and verified withdrawals. Help readers inspect sources, distinguish evidence from tone, and challenge notes. Labels reflect supplied sources, not guarantees of truth.
howTo: Open Evidence desk and select a community note. Read Evidence and Tone separately. Reading does not require a wallet.
Read The sources and open each citation. Compare the exact quotation with its public source.

Select temperature-update-2025 and switch between v1 Unsupported and v2 Supported in Follow the changes. Inspect the added NASA source. Open Live proof and the proof manifest for the two-wallet appeal, settlement receipts and exact balances.

Connect MetaMask with the GenLayer plugin and simulated GEN on StudioNet. Choose Write a note: Stake bond, wait for finality, then Publish note. To challenge, Fund appeal · 2 GEN, then Contest note. Inspect decision or cancellation and verified withdrawals. The public demo appeal window is 15 minutes; production default is 72 hours.
